# ML Reporting

Use the detailed Copilot Agent Skill at `.github/skills/ml-reporting/SKILL.md` when generating or reviewing Marp slides.

Always preserve these short rules:

- Include purpose, evaluation method, limitations, and next actions.
- Tie conclusions to metrics and evaluation conditions.
- Do not overstate evidence.
- Copy referenced images into `artifacts/presentation/images/` and use relative paths.
